dataset.name: Northstar Commerce Analytics
dataset.subtitle: Orders, customers and product performance
dataset.description: A compact e-commerce analytics model connecting customer profiles, product categories and transaction-level orders. Each order is linked to one customer and one product.
lifecycle: A customer registers and is assigned a stable customer identifier.
Products are categorized for assortment and segmentation analysis.
Each order records a product purchase by a customer, a quantity, the sale amount and the order status.
overview_notes: Order amounts are measured in USD major units. The supplied sample is a generator smoke test, not a production-scale dataset.
conventions: All monetary amounts shown are USD major units, not cents.
Order dates use ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD values.
Use the order grain when summing order revenue; do not duplicate orders by joining to other many-valued event tables.

quality_checks.name: Primary keys
quality_checks.rule: All customer_id, product_id and order_id values are unique and non-null.

quality_checks.name: Foreign keys
quality_checks.rule: Every order customer_id and product_id exists in the respective dimension.

limitations: This three-table example illustrates the skill generator and does not demonstrate financial reconciliation or complex event lifecycles.
use_cases: Revenue by product category and month
Order completion rate by customer segment
Orders and average ticket by channel
